# Srikanth Kalyanasundaram

> Srikanth Kalyanasundaram, M.IOD, is a Mumbai-based HR leader, entrepreneur and mentor with over two decades building people-centred, high-performance organisations. He started as a mechanical engineer, moved into HR, and now helps students and early-career professionals cross the bridge from campus to corporate. Tagline: "Elevating People, Empowering Futures." He was profiled in "Leadership Spotlight: The Engineer Who Learned to Read People" by The 365 Circle: C-Suite Advantage.

## Four practices
- Campus: Campus-to-Corporate Readiness. The signature 12-week Mindful Professional 360° programme, placement readiness cohorts for colleges, graduate trainee bootcamps for companies.
- Respect: Building Respect, Enabling Safe Workplaces. POSH compliance and Internal Committee training for institutions, workplace dignity, culture transformation.
- Inspire: Unlock Potential, Inspire Growth, Elevate Lives. Leadership development, mentoring and career growth, wellbeing and mindfulness, personal effectiveness coaching, retained HR advisory.
- Benefits: Employee Benefits Advisory. Independent advice for employers on benefits design, employee wellbeing, and benefits operations and governance. Advice only: no insurance is sold, solicited or arranged.

## Key facts
- Based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; delivers on campus and on site across India.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, Marathi.
- Education: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Coimbatore Institute of Technology; Post Graduate Diploma in HR Management, Welingkar Institute, Mumbai.
- Certifications: ESG (Institute of Directors), POSH (Indian Society for Training and Development), Happiness Coaching (Berkeley Institute of Well Being), Mindfulness Coaching (Happiitude), Train the Trainer (NSDC and MEPSC), Business Storytelling (NIST).
- Approach: human-led and AI-augmented; experiential practice, feedback and simulation rather than lectures; every college cohort is assessed before and after.
- Contact: mtmdselflove@gmail.com, or the form at https://srikanthk.pages.dev/contact. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/campus2corporate
